commit_message:
fix: pin each redirect to its expected leaf key; re-raise swallowed errors

Adversarial review of #3: a layer that writes another key first (companion
container, audit record) received the operation's semantics; now the leaf
refuses any write but the expected (method, key). Errors a layer catches are
re-raised; subclasses scoping by __contains__ are checked; messages no longer
claim a deferred write was not performed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
